description: A submit button's label written `<INPUT TYPE="SUBMIT" VALUE="Send">`. The DOM draws an `<input type="submit">` labelled `Send` (measured through ngc in partial mode, the linker and a render in jsdom), so `value` speaks here. The three names and the type are in capitals, so reading any one of the tag, `type`, its value or `value` exactly lets the label through. The package entry carries the pairs the linker writes; neither name speaks, so point 2 compares neither.
